name: Gernx Profit Dashboard for WooCommerce – Profit Tracking, Cost of Goods & Profit Reports
author: Tanmoy Biswas

sections.description:
Gernx Profit Dashboard is a WooCommerce profit tracking plugin that shows your real profit, not just revenue. You enter the cost of each product once, and it calculates net profit, profit margin and cost of goods (COGS) for every order, every product and every period, with animated profit charts on each report. No spreadsheets, no manual exports.

Most WooCommerce stores only see sales. Sales hide the truth: product costs and refunds quietly eat your margin. This WooCommerce profit plugin closes that gap so you always know what you actually keep.

Why track WooCommerce profit

Revenue tells you the store is busy. Profit tells you whether being busy is worth it. If you sell a product for 120 that costs you 55, your real profit is 65 before refunds, not 120. Across hundreds of orders that difference decides whether the business works. Gernx Profit Dashboard surfaces that number automatically, so profit tracking becomes something you glance at, not a monthly spreadsheet project.

Free features

  • Product cost field on simple and variable products (cost of goods)
  • Profit per order, calculated and cached on every WooCommerce order
  • Profit column in the WooCommerce orders list (HPOS and legacy)
  • Product profitability report with Top profit, Top revenue and Lowest profit views
  • Profit overview with revenue, cost of goods, net profit, margin and a daily chart
  • Animated profit charts on every report screen: a Profit Trend area chart, a Daily Profit column chart with losses below the zero line, a Most Profitable Products bar chart, and a Revenue vs Profit period chart
  • Profit reports by day, week, month and year
  • WordPress dashboard widget showing this month’s profit
  • Gutenberg “Profit Summary” block (shown to shop managers only)
  • Two Elementor widgets in a “Gernx Widgets” category: Profit Summary and Profit Stat (shop managers only)
  • HPOS compatible and built on the official WooCommerce CRUD API
  • Lightweight by design: charts are inline SVG with no external chart libraries, and animations respect the prefers-reduced-motion setting

The free plugin is fully functional on its own.

Upgrade to Pro

Gernx Profit Dashboard Pro is a separate add-on that turns the dashboard into a complete WooCommerce profit analytics suite:

  • Customer profitability reports: see which buyers actually earn you money
  • Country profitability with a profit-share pie chart
  • Refund analysis with a refunded-vs-kept chart
  • Expenses and fees tracking, with net profit after expenses
  • Inventory value (stock at cost, retail value and potential profit)
  • Profit forecasting, monthly run-rate and break-even
  • CSV export for product, customer, country, refund and expense reports
  • Five extra Elementor widgets (Top Products, Top Customers, Country Profit, Refund Summary, Net After Expenses)

Learn more, see the live demo and upgrade at gernx.com/profit-dashboard.

sections.installation:
1. Install Gernx Profit Dashboard for WooCommerce from Plugins, Add New, or upload the zip.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Enter a Cost value on your products (Product data, General tab).
  4. Open Profit Dashboard, Overview and click “Recalculate all orders” once to backfill existing orders.
sections.faq:
How does the plugin calculate WooCommerce profit?

For each order it takes revenue (by default excluding tax and shipping), subtracts the cost of goods from your product Cost fields, and subtracts refunds. The result is net profit, and margin is profit divided by revenue.

Does it support HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Compatibility is declared and all order access uses the official WooCommerce methods.

Will it slow down my store?

No. Profit is calculated when an order changes and stored, so reports read pre-calculated numbers. The charts are inline SVG with no external libraries.

Do customers ever see profit figures?

No. Every figure, including the block and Elementor widgets, is shown only to logged-in users who can manage WooCommerce.

A report shows no data. What do I do?

Open Profit Dashboard, Overview and click “Recalculate all orders” once. New orders are tracked automatically. Report ranges go up to one year.

Where are the Elementor widgets?

In the Elementor editor, open the widget panel and look for the “Gernx Widgets” category.

What does the Pro add-on include?

Customer, country, refund, expenses, inventory and forecasting reports, CSV export and five extra Elementor widgets. See gernx.com/profit-dashboard for details and a live demo.
sections.changelog:
1.3.4

  • New: animated SVG charts across the dashboard – a Profit Trend area chart on the Overview, a Daily Profit column chart (with losses below the zero line) on Orders Profit, a Most Profitable Products bar chart on Product Profitability, and a Revenue vs Profit period chart on Profit Reports.
  • All charts are drawn as inline SVG with no external libraries, animate on load, and respect the prefers-reduced-motion setting.
  • Updated documentation and upgrade links.
  • Rewrote readme with clearer feature descriptions and an Upgrade to Pro section.

1.3.3

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0.
  • Replaced the deprecated current_time( ‘timestamp’ ) calls with current_datetime() for timezone-correct date ranges across the dashboard, reports, block and Elementor widgets.

1.3.2

  • Fully-functional free build with no locked screens or premium-only code.
  • Enqueue all styles and scripts; removed early translation loading.
  • Elementor widgets in a “Gernx Widgets” category (Profit Summary, Profit Stat).
  • Diagnostics panel and self-healing database setup so reports populate reliably.

1.2.0

  • Product Profitability views: Top profit, Top revenue, Lowest profit.
  • Refund tracking with automatic in-place database upgrade.

1.1.0

  • Profit reports and product profitability improvements.

1.0.2

  • Initial release: cost fields, order profit, reports, dashboard widget, Gutenberg block, Elementor widget.
